dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: How are things at Falcon Coast?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, it's kinda hard to explain.

choices.text: It's too early to say for sure.

response.speaker: Adelinde
response.text: Fair enough. Well, I don't know the first thing about combat situations anyway, so you can spare yourselves the ordeal of trying to explain it all to me.

response.speaker: Adelinde
response.text: If there's anything you need, let me know, and I'll sort it out.

response.speaker: Adelinde
response.text: I'll be right here when you need me.

choices.text: We need to keep monitoring the situation for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that how it is...

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Haha, you're overthinking things, that's just nonsense.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: ...Ah, yes. How's your appetite been recently?

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: I made some extra steaks today. If you're not picky, please take them.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Like I said, don't overthink it. These are perfectly normal animal steaks. There's nothing wrong with them at all... *chuckles*

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Greetings, welcome to Dawn Winery.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Master Kaeya?

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: You know him? I trust he's doing well for himself lately.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: If you're asking about the title, that's all in the past...

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Sorry, that was a slip of the tongue... Please disregard it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: I am the head housemaid. Please come to me if you ever need help with anything at the winery.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: My work? Just housekeeping. Most of the time it's just cleaning the rooms and taking out the trash, nothing strenuous.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What can you tell me about the rumors?

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Was it Moco and Hillie you heard that from? *sigh* It sounds like they've been telling tall tales to the guests again...

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Don't take them too seriously. Nothing they tell you is worth paying too much attention to.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Did you really think there could be quite so much drama... Heh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Adelinde
dialogues.text: Farewell. I hope your time here gave you a brief moment of respite.
